data.name: Abandoned
data.value: The routine couldn't be stopped on the server.

data.name: AbandonedRunning
data.value: Server process {0} may still be running and holding its locks.

data.name: AbandonedSession
data.value: Its server session may still be running and holding its locks.

data.name: AbandonedWaiting
data.value: Server process {0} may still be waiting for a debugger and holding its locks. To end it, run SELECT pldbg_attach_to_port({1}) and pass the number it returns to pldbg_abort_target.
data.comment: {0} is a server process id, {1} a port number. The SELECT and function names are SQL.

data.name: CannotStepOut
data.value: The PL/pgSQL debugger can't step out of a routine.

data.name: DefaultNotReadable
data.value: This server can't show the default value of {0}, so enter a value for it.

data.name: ExtensionMissing
data.value: The PL/pgSQL debugger isn't installed in "{0}".

data.name: ExtensionMissingDetail
data.value: Ask a superuser to run CREATE EXTENSION pldbgapi in this database.

data.name: HidesDebuggerNotice
data.value: This routine sets client_min_messages to {0}, which hides the notice the debugger starts with.
data.comment: {0} is a client_min_messages level, such as warning.

data.name: HidesDebuggerNoticeDetail
data.value: Remove SET client_min_messages from the routine to debug it.

data.name: Interrupted
data.value: The debugger's session was interrupted while it waited, so the routine was stopped and its uncommitted changes were rolled back. A cancel or the server's transaction_timeout can cause this.

data.name: LimitsTransactionTime
data.value: This routine sets transaction_timeout to {0}, which would end it while it waits at a breakpoint.

data.name: LimitsTransactionTimeDetail
data.value: Remove SET transaction_timeout from the routine to debug it.

data.name: NoDefault
data.value: {0} has no default value.

data.name: NoOverloads
data.value: {0} has no PL/pgSQL overload that can be debugged.

data.name: NoOverloadsDetail
data.value: Only PL/pgSQL functions and procedures without polymorphic, record or trigger signatures can be debugged.

data.name: NotAStorageParameter
data.value: "{0}" is not a storage parameter. Write each as name=value.
data.comment: {0} is the text entered. name=value is literal.

data.name: NotDebuggable
data.value: Only PL/pgSQL functions and procedures can be debugged.

data.name: NotOwner
data.value: Only the owner of {0} or a superuser can debug it.

data.name: NotPaused
data.value: The routine isn't paused.

data.name: PseudoTypeParameter
data.value: Routines with polymorphic or record parameters can't be debugged.

data.name: RoutineNotFound
data.value: {0} no longer exists.

data.name: RunNoteFunction
data.value: Changes the routine makes are committed when it finishes. Stop rolls them back.

data.name: RunNoteProcedure
data.value: Changes the procedure makes are committed when it commits or finishes. Stop rolls back what it hasn't committed.

data.name: ServerPackageMissing
data.value: This server has no PL/pgSQL debugger.

data.name: ServerPackageMissingDetail
data.value: Install the pldebugger package for this PostgreSQL version on the server, then run CREATE EXTENSION pldbgapi in this database.

data.name: SharedMemoryUnavailable
data.value: The server couldn't start the debugger.

data.name: SharedMemoryUnavailableDetail
data.value: Add plugin_debugger to shared_preload_libraries and restart the server.

data.name: Stopped
data.value: The routine was stopped, and its uncommitted changes were rolled back.

data.name: Unavailable
data.value: This connection can't run the PL/pgSQL debugger.
